correctness.rationale: The invariant edge restrictions give H_t and V_s; the four corners count once and the open-edge roots are disjoint. Only V_s can be the zero polynomial, with exactly the stated three coefficient conditions. Two upper horizontal interior roots force a<0 because the two endpoint signs agree with a and the values sum to −2; two lower interior roots similarly force a>0. For a<0 the opposite horizontal polynomial is a(u²−1)+1+(λ−b)u and is strictly positive inside even at |λ−b|=1; for |λ−b|>1 it has exactly one interior root by opposite endpoint signs and degree two. The reflected argument handles a>0. The two-root test follows from the vertex, discriminant, and endpoint signs. Independent exact algebraic root counts reproduced the eight finite witnesses; all four transverse polynomial gcds are constant and the four corner eigenvalue pairs are nonzero at the sharp witness. This certifies simultaneous hyperbolicity there and nearby, not at every parameter in the chamber.
